:::: {.content-visible unless-profile="ja"}

Compare the relative decrease in bending and tensile stiffness from 100% to 80% RWC. This is Figure S2 in the manuscript. Its GAMs use RWC of at least 60%, matching Figures 1–3.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

RWC 100%から80%までの曲げ剛性と引張剛性の相対的な低下を比較します。
論文の図S2に相当します。
GAMの当てはめには、図1～3と同じRWC 60%以上の基準を用います。

::::

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
source("R/setup.R")

# Load data
df_list <- list()
df_list[["bending"]] <- read.csv("outputs/tables/bending.csv")
df_list[["tensile"]] <- read.csv("outputs/tables/tensile.csv")

spp <- c(
  "ubayuri",
  "youshuyamagobou",
  "yurinoki",
  "niseakashia",
  "aoki",
  "nezumimochi"
) # species names
names(spp) <- c(
  "Cardiocrinum_cordatum",
  "Phytolacca_americana",
  "Liriodendron_tulipifera",
  "Robinia_pseudoacacia",
  "Aucuba_japonica",
  "Ligustrum lucidum"
)
```

## Bending

## 曲げ試験

::::

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
categories <- c("bending", "tensile")
df <- df_list[[categories[1]]]
df <- df[df$water_content >= 60, ] # filter data for water content >= 60%
df$EI <- df$EI * 1000 # convert unit of EI
df$I <- df$I * 1000 # convert unit of I
```

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
# (A) - (F) RWC vs EI
adaxial_result_list <- lapply(seq_along(spp), function(i) {
  sp <- spp[i]
  df_sp <- df[df$spp == sp, ]
  df_adaxial <- droplevels(subset(df_sp, leaf_side == "adaxial"))
  # Plot adaxial side
  result_adaxial <- plot_gam_ci(
    data = df_adaxial,
    x = "water_content",
    y = "EI",
    side = "adaxial",
    pred_range = c(60, 100),
    xlim = c(100, 60)
  )
})

abaxial_result_list <- lapply(seq_along(spp), function(i) {
  sp <- spp[i]
  df_sp <- df[df$spp == sp, ]
  df_abaxial <- droplevels(subset(df_sp, leaf_side == "abaxial"))
  # Add abaxial side to the same plot
  result <- plot_gam_ci(
    data = df_abaxial,
    x = "water_content",
    y = "EI",
    side = "abaxial",
    pred_range = c(60, 100),
    xlim = c(100, 60),
    pch = 22 # Use different point shape for abaxial
  )
})

df_list_adaxial <- lapply(seq_along(adaxial_result_list), function(i) {
  x <- adaxial_result_list[[i]]$newdata$water_content
  y <- adaxial_result_list[[i]]$fit
  df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, species = names(spp)[i], side = "adaxial")
})
df_list_abaxial <- lapply(seq_along(abaxial_result_list), function(i) {
  x <- abaxial_result_list[[i]]$newdata$water_content
  y <- abaxial_result_list[[i]]$fit
  df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, species = names(spp)[i], side = "abaxial")
})
df_adaxial <- do.call(rbind, df_list_adaxial)
df_abaxial <- do.call(rbind, df_list_abaxial)
df_merged <- rbind(df_adaxial, df_abaxial)
```

## Tensile

## 引張試験

::::

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
# Load data
df_list <- list()
df_list[["tensile"]] <- read.csv("outputs/tables/tensile.csv")
categories <- c("bending", "tensile")
df <- add_tensile_stiffness(df_list[[categories[2]]])
df <- df[df$water_content >= 60, ] # filter data for water content >= 60%

df$I <- df$I * 1000 # convert unit of I
df$LMA <- df$dry_weight / df$area * 10^3 # calculate leaf mass per area (LMA) (g m-2)
df$density <- df$dry_weight / df$thickness # calculate leaf density (kg m-3)
df$E_per_density <- df$E.x / df$density # calculate E per density (MPa kg m-3)
df$E_per_density <- df$E_per_density * 10^3 # convert unit of E per density (MPa g m-3)
```

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
side <- "tensile"
# (A) - (F) RWC vs EA
tensile_result_list <- lapply(seq_along(spp), function(i) {
  sp <- spp[i]
  df_sp <- df[df$spp == sp, ]
  # Plot adaxial side
  result <- plot_gam_ci(
    data = df_sp,
    x = "water_content",
    y = "EA",
    side = side,
    pred_range = c(60, 100),
    xlim = c(100, 60)
  )
  return(result)
})
df_list_tensile <- lapply(seq_along(tensile_result_list), function(i) {
  x <- tensile_result_list[[i]]$newdata$water_content
  y <- tensile_result_list[[i]]$fit
  df <- data.frame(x = x, y = y, species = names(spp)[i], side = "tensile")
})
df_tensile <- do.call(rbind, df_list_tensile)
df_merged <- rbind(df_merged, df_tensile)
```

## Relative stiffness decrease from 100% to 80% RWC

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

## RWC 100%から80%までの剛性の相対的な低下

::::

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
list_drop_adaxial <- lapply(seq_along(spp), function(i) {
  sp <- names(spp)[i]
  df_sp <- df_merged[df_merged$species == sp & df_merged$side == "adaxial", ]
  ei_100 <- df_sp$y[which.min(abs(df_sp$x - 100))]
  ei_80 <- df_sp$y[which.min(abs(df_sp$x - 80))]
  drop <- (ei_100 - ei_80) / ei_100 * 100
  df_drop <- data.frame(
    species = sp,
    side = "adaxial",
    ei_100 = ei_100,
    ei_80 = ei_80,
    drop = drop
  )
})

list_drop_abaxial <- lapply(seq_along(spp), function(i) {
  sp <- names(spp)[i]
  df_sp <- df_merged[df_merged$species == sp & df_merged$side == "abaxial", ]
  ei_100 <- df_sp$y[which.min(abs(df_sp$x - 100))]
  ei_80 <- df_sp$y[which.min(abs(df_sp$x - 80))]
  drop <- (ei_100 - ei_80) / ei_100 * 100
  df_drop <- data.frame(
    species = sp,
    side = "abaxial",
    ei_100 = ei_100,
    ei_80 = ei_80,
    drop = drop
  )
})

list_drop_tensile <- lapply(seq_along(spp), function(i) {
  sp <- names(spp)[i]
  df_sp <- df_merged[df_merged$species == sp & df_merged$side == "tensile", ]
  ei_100 <- df_sp$y[which.min(abs(df_sp$x - 100))]
  ei_80 <- df_sp$y[which.min(abs(df_sp$x - 80))]
  drop <- (ei_100 - ei_80) / ei_100 * 100
  df_drop <- data.frame(
    species = sp,
    side = "tensile",
    ei_100 = ei_100,
    ei_80 = ei_80,
    drop = drop
  )
})

df_drop <- as.data.frame(do.call(
  rbind,
  c(list_drop_adaxial, list_drop_abaxial, list_drop_tensile)
))
df_drop[
  df_drop$species == "Ligustrum lucidum" & df_drop$side == "abaxial",
  "drop"
] <- NA

df_wide <- reshape(
  df_drop[, c("species", "side", "drop")],
  idvar = "species",
  timevar = "side",
  direction = "wide",
  sep = "_"
)
```

## 比較図の作成

::::

```{r}
#| results: hide
#| fig-show: hide
cex_pt <- 3 # Point size
pt_fill_alpha <- 0.5 # Transparency of points
pt_border_alpha <- 0.9 # Transparency of point borders
cex.axis <- 2.5 # Axis label size
cex.lab <- 2.5 # Axis label size
mgp_x <- c(3, 1.5, 0)
mgp_y <- c(3, 0.5, 0) # Margins for axis labels
line_alpha <- 0.9 # Transparency of regression lines
line_width <- 4 # Line width

svg("outputs/figures/figure_S2.svg", bg = "transparent")
par(mar = c(3, 4, 0.6, 0.6))
# Include negative decreases (predicted stiffness increases) in the plot.
plot_limits <- range(c(0, 100, unlist(df_wide[, c(
  "drop_tensile", "drop_adaxial", "drop_abaxial")])), na.rm = TRUE)
plot(
  df_wide$drop_tensile,
  df_wide$drop_adaxial,
  xlim = plot_limits,
  ylim = plot_limits,
  xlab = "",
  ylab = "",
  asp = 1,
  type = "n",
  xaxt = "n",
  yaxt = "n"
)
abline(0, 1, lty = 2, lwd = 3) # 1:1 line

# Adaxial
points(
  df_wide$drop_tensile,
  df_wide$drop_adaxial,
  pch = 21,
  cex = cex_pt,
  bg = adjustcolor(7, alpha.f = pt_fill_alpha),
  col = adjustcolor(7, alpha.f = pt_border_alpha)
)
# Abaxial
points(
  df_wide$drop_tensile,
  df_wide$drop_abaxial,
  pch = 22,
  cex = cex_pt,
  bg = adjustcolor(6, alpha.f = pt_fill_alpha),
  col = adjustcolor(6, alpha.f = pt_border_alpha)
)

# Regression lines and statistics
# Adaxial
model_adaxial <- lm(
  drop_adaxial ~ drop_tensile,
  data = df_wide,
  na.action = na.exclude
)
abline(
  model_adaxial,
  col = adjustcolor(7, alpha.f = line_alpha),
  lwd = line_width
)
print(summary(model_adaxial))

# Abaxial
model_abaxial <- lm(
  drop_abaxial ~ drop_tensile,
  data = df_wide,
  na.action = na.exclude
)
abline(
  model_abaxial,
  col = adjustcolor(6, alpha.f = line_alpha),
  lwd = line_width
)
print(summary(model_abaxial))

# Axis
axis(2, las = 2, cex.axis = cex.axis, mgp = mgp_y)
axis(1, cex.axis = cex.axis, mgp = mgp_x)
dev.off()
saveRDS(list(data = df_wide, adaxial = model_adaxial, abaxial = model_abaxial),
        "outputs/tables/stiffness-comparison.rds")
```

## 回帰分析の結果

::::

```{r}
#| label: stiffness-regression-results
regression_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Adaxial", "Abaxial"), function(side) {
  model <- if (side == "Adaxial") model_adaxial else model_abaxial
  model_summary <- summary(model)
  data.frame(side = side, species = nobs(model), intercept = unname(coef(model)[1]),
    slope = unname(coef(model)[2]), R2 = model_summary$r.squared,
    adjusted_R2 = model_summary$adj.r.squared, p = coef(model_summary)[2, 4])
}))
knitr::kable(regression_summary, digits = c(0, 0, 3, 3, 3, 3, 5), row.names = FALSE)
```

:::: {.content-visible unless-profile="ja"}

The inherited analysis excludes the abaxial value for *Ligustrum lucidum* by
assigning it `NA`. The abaxial regression therefore uses five species.
Both ordinary and adjusted R² are shown to clarify the manuscript reporting.

::::

:::: {.content-visible when-profile="ja"}

元の解析では、*Ligustrum lucidum* の背軸側の値を `NA` として除外しています。
そのため、背軸側の回帰には5種を用います。
論文中の記載を確認できるように、通常のR²と自由度調整済みR²の両方を示します。
